name: 下载专家
tagline: Turns long video and audio into readable Chinese transcripts
description: A Chinese-language study aid for people who learn from long recordings. Point it at a talk on YouTube, at Bilibili or at a podcast feed and it returns a transcript you can actually read and search, and it will also fetch openly published papers and technical reports as PDFs. Transcription uses your own cloud key.
author: kin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
